environment.description: Same NestJS microservice on EKS 1.28 with pod security admission enforcing 'restricted' profile. Container securityContext specifies drop: [ALL] with explicit add: [NET_BIND_SERVICE] only. Additionally, a Cilium L7 network policy is applied on the pod's egress that performs protocol-aware LDAP inspection — the CiliumNetworkPolicy uses an l7 rule with `l7proto: ldap` and a `filter` stanza that restricts search operations to filters matching the regex pattern `^\(&\(objectClass=person\)\(uid=[a-zA-Z0-9._-]{1,64}\)\(department=engineering\)\)$`. Any LDAP search request whose filter does not match this pattern is dropped at the network layer before reaching the LDAP server. The Cilium agent runs as a DaemonSet with eBPF-based L7 parsing enabled (--enable-l7-proxy=true, --l7-proxy-mode=envoy). CAP_NET_RAW and CAP_SYS_ADMIN are dropped from the application container.
